title: Counter-Strike 2
notes: Use DXMT (the recommended renderer): it identifies as an AMD card, so the game skips NVAPI. Under DXVK/wined3d the GPU can be reported as a fake NVIDIA, and CS2 then fails with 'Failed to initialize NVAPI (0xFFFFFFFE)' — same as Proton. If stuck on DXVK, set bottle env DXVK_CONFIG="dxgi.customVendorId = 1002". Blank screen with exclusive fullscreen + MSAA fixed in DXMT 0.73. VAC is userspace — playable but use at own judgement.

anticheat.note: anti-cheat present; Linux/Proton support does not extend to macOS — userspace path works for some titles
